transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's this cough. Just won't go away.
When did the cough first start, and did it come on suddenly or gradually?
About three weeks back. Started after a cold.
Can you tell me how much the cough has been affecting your day-to-day life, and whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
My wife keeps on at me to get it looked at.
Could you tell me about any medicines you’ve been taking recently — regular ones, or anything new or changed — and the dose if you know it?
I'm using my blue inhaler more. Four or five times a day now.
Any allergies or bad reactions to medicines, or are you not sure?
No allergies that I know of.
Have you got any long-term health conditions?
Yes, I've got COPD. Had it about eight years.
How much is the cough bothering you day to day — not much, somewhat, or a lot, or you're not sure?
It's a lot. Wakes me most nights — six out of ten.
Can you describe what else you’ve noticed along with the cough, and where you feel it — does it stay in one spot or go anywhere else?
Bit more breathless than usual, walking to the shop.
Have you noticed anything that seems to make your cough better or worse?
Cold air sets it off.
Apart from your COPD, is there anything else you see a doctor or nurse about regularly?
Just my blood pressure, nothing else.
Where do you feel the cough most, and does that feeling spread anywhere else?
In my chest, mostly. Bringing up white-yellow phlegm.
What’s been on your mind most about this cough, and what are you hoping we can help with today?
Worried my lungs are getting worse. Or it could be cancer.
Since this cough started, have you noticed any other changes, like in your appetite, sleep, weight, energy, bladder or bowel habits, or your breathing? It’s okay to say no.
No weight loss. The wife's been fussing over me.
When you cough, what does it feel like in your chest?
Tight in the chest, and phlegmy.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed since this cough started that we haven’t talked about yet?
No blood in it, thank goodness.
Besides what you’ve already told me, is there anything else about how you’ve been feeling since the cough started that you think I should know?
Steam helps a bit. My grandson's had a cough too, kids share everything.
Are you taking any medicines at the moment, either ones you take regularly or anything new or changed recently?
I use a Fostair inhaler, two puffs twice daily.
Besides your inhalers, is there anything else you take for your COPD, like tablets or other medicines?
Just a little tablet for my blood pressure.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
